content.title: 2026 Kentucky Derby in Louisville - Princeton Group Sports
content.text: « All Events HORSE RACING AT ITS FINEST Every year, Kentucky Derby is one of the most highly anticipated sporting events of the Spring. Held on the first Saturday of May, the Kentucky Derby is the first leg of the Triple Crown and offers the largest purse of any thoroughbred race at $2,000,000.Let us show you how to Derby in Style Horse racing's premier event is held in Lousiville, Kentucky the first weekend in May. Enjoy watching horse racing's elite groups compete for the roses and lilies in the dirt track at Churchill Downs. Princeton Group works with large corporations, family-owned businesses, and individuals who want to enjoy the energy and splendor of Louisville. Let Princeton Group do all the work to ensure that everything is smooth and easy for you and your valued guests. Our programs include high-end hotel accommodations, exclusive tours, and event access, as well as a dedicated operations team to answer questions and plan your event prior to your arrival in Lousiville. Watch Princeton Group in LouisvilleTHE PRINCETON GROUP EXPERIENCE With seating options in every section of Churchill Downs, we can accommodate every group's needs and preferences.Visit a Kentucky horse farm and learn about the state's long history in the sport. Also, visit a distillery along the famous Bourbon Trail - tour the facility and have a taste!We offer dedicated customer service prior to and during the event. Have questions or need help planning? We are here for you!WHY CHOOSE PRINCETON GROUP? We have many years of providing customers a high-class experience at both The Kentucky Derby and The Kentucky Oaks. The event is more than just attending a horse race. With exclusive access, unique tours, and access to exclusive parties, it is a weekend unlike any other.Princeton Group has no partnerships, affiliation, or other relationship with the Kentucky Derby or Churchill Downs.
